_notes: ScioSense ENS160 digital metal-oxide multi-gas sensor (Adafruit and SparkFun boards) at 0x53 (default, ADDR high) or 0x52. Detection: PART_ID (0x00, 2 bytes little-endian) = 0x0160. Init: OPMODE (0x10) idle (0x01), then compensation TEMP_IN (0x13, kelvin x 64) = 25 degC and RH_IN (0x15, %RH x 512) = 50 %RH in one write, then OPMODE standard (0x02), which measures once a second. Poll (1 s): 6 bytes from DEVICE_STATUS (0x20): status, DATA_AQI (UBA air quality index 1-5, bits 2:0), DATA_TVOC (ppb) and DATA_ECO2 (ppm), both little-endian. Status: STATAS (bit 7) = an operating mode is running, STATER (bit 6) = error, VALIDITY (bits 3:2) 0 = normal, 1 = warm-up (the first 3 min after each power-on), 2 = initial start-up (the first hour of operation in the sensor's life), 3 = invalid output; NEWDAT (bit 1) = new data, NEWGPR (bit 0) = new general-purpose register data; the status labels are S (STATAS), E (STATER), D (NEWDAT) and G (NEWGPR), with the validity bits left to the validity attribute. Readings during warm-up or initial start-up are not yet reliable. The compensation actions take degC and %RH (e.g. from another sensor); the mode action switches between deep sleep, idle and standard.

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-23): the chip ignores bit 7 of the register address, so the lone 0x99 points at 0x19 and the 9-byte read covers 0x19-0x21, ending with DEVICE_STATUS and DATA_AQI. No configuration register changed (OPMODE, CONFIG, TEMP_IN, RH_IN) and measuring carried on; reading DATA_AQI may clear the NEWDAT flag (transient)

actions.desc: Ambient temperature for compensation, in degC (e.g. from another sensor)
Ambient relative humidity for compensation, in %RH
Operating mode: standard measures once a second; deep sleep uses least power
